text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. At its meeting of September 6, 2017, Etobicoke York Community Council considered Item EY24.48, approving that a survey of property owners/occupants be conducted on Tarragona Boulevard, between Symes Road and Gunns Road to determine community support for a proposed traffic calming plan. This report summarizes the result of the traffic calming poll for owners and occupants of Tarragona Road, between Symes Road and Gunns Road. Polling ballots were mailed to the affected residents on October 12, 2017 and 46% of the residents on Tarragona Boulevard responded to the polling. As a result, the minimum response rate of 50% plus 1 votes needed to proceed with the installation were not achieved.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of traffic calming on Tarragona Boulevard, between Symes Road and Gunns Road. 2. Requested the City Solicitor to prepare a draft by-law for installing three speed humps on Tarragona Boulevard, between Symes Road and Gunns Road, as shown on Drawing EY 17-055 dated May 2017.
